name: contingency
lore:
### Contingency: The Patient Sentinel

To cast *Contingency* is to stitch a deliberate knot into the fabric of causality. As the ritual concludes, the Weave feels agonizingly taut—a vibrating bowstring held at full draw, awaiting a release that may not come for days. Visually, the magic manifests as a faint, translucent lattice of silver threads that clings to the caster’s skin like spectral frost before fading into the ethereal.

Legend attributes its discovery to Archmage Malakor the Vigilant. Obsessed with his own fragility, Malakor spent decades studying the "Echo of the Moment." He sought a way to ensure his magic could act even if his mind was clouded or his heart stopped. It is said he finally succeeded by binding his intent to a sliver of a chronomantic paradox, forcing a future spell to inhabit the present.

Be warned: the spell’s presence is a constant, low-frequency thrum in the marrow of your bones. It is the magic of the prepared mind—a silent guardian that breathes only when the world turns against you.
